scene: You reach the top balcony of the lighthouse overlooking the neon bay.
picture: Side-scrolling view inside the open red lighthouse balcony. Far left, a brass telescope points out toward the sea. The top-knotted player in floral shirt stands left with his ukulele. Centre, a bronze bell hangs from painted rafters. Right, a taut zipline wire anchors to a heavy wooden post by the balcony rail.
shown: a mounted brass telescope pointing outward on the far left rail
a heavy cast bronze signal bell hanging centre under the curved roof
a taut overhead zipline cable fastened right leading off the balcony
